timezone: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+08:00); timestamps have no source timezone marker
time_grid: filename hour; each row has capture_time in UTC epoch seconds. An h:00 slot is a collection-round index, not an instantaneous h:00 observation.
cutoff_rule: For any training cutoff also require capture_time <= cutoff_epoch; derive hour/day calendar features from actual capture_time.
domain_only: UID exists in source CS_meta; six counts finite nonnegative integers; capacity>0; occupied+available<=capacity per AC/DC; capture parses. Raw file metric basic_valid refers to this domain-only check.
basic: Same causal clock, status, repeated-capture and bulk-failure rules as strict; relax only occupied+available==capacity to <=capacity. No interpolation.
strict: basic plus not explicitly closed/private/in-construction, |capture_time-filename_exact_time|<=90 minutes, exclude subsequent identical capture timestamps per station, require occupied+available==capacity separately for AC/DC, and exclude an hour if >=95% station reports have all six counts zero and positive-capacity fraction is <=10% of the first observed official-window snapshot positive-capacity fraction (known at t0).
occupancy_rate: computed for domain_valid, eligibility chosen separately by valid/basic_valid; no label imputation
public_cohort_exclusion: Closed/private status defines the public-cohort scope and is not proof of faulty numeric telemetry; blank/unknown status remains eligible.
frozen: Unchanged six-count state across consecutive basic-valid collection hours is flagged at 24/48/72h, not automatically removed from basic/strict. Constant legitimate low-demand sites remain valid.
source_update: Baidu update time is audited but semantics are not proved to represent charging telemetry freshness; no automatic label deletion based solely on this metadata clock.
bulk_failure_reference: First observed official-window snapshot positive-capacity fraction (known at t0); never a full-period median.
clock_sensitivity_reference: Exact filename time including minutes/seconds, matching primary rule
closed_or_private_status_regex: 暂停|不对外|关闭|搬迁|在建|停业|未开放|未营业|停止|内部
